anomalies.observed: On the second sheet a wire (highlighted green) runs from U1 pin 2 (the LM1117 VO output, net +5V) down to U3 pin 2 (PB3, labelled POT) and to the op-amp's pin 3, so the +5V supply rail and the POT signal net are joined together. J3 pin 2 also carries the POT label, so the potentiometer wiper is tied straight to +5V.
anomalies.expected: The POT net should connect only the potentiometer wiper (J3 pin 2) to the MCU analog input (U3 pin 2) and the op-amp input; the LM1117 output (+5V) must not be merged with it. The regulated +5V should feed only the logic supply and pull-ups (R3, R6), while the pot sense line remains a high-impedance analog input.

anomalies.impact: The potentiometer input is pinned to the 5V rail, so the MCU ADC always reads full scale and the fan-speed-from-pot control is lost; the pot wiper also fights the regulator, potentially over-currenting the LM1117 and the pot.
